tools.description: Read one URL in an isolated temporary context. Returns text, links and status, then destroys the context. No continuation or auth state.

Open a run-owned server browser across public HTTP(S) origins for 15 minutes; its page can be viewed and controlled by the owner in Web. Returns session ID, expiry, observation version and value-free forms metadata. For public GET search forms prefer browser.submit_get_form; follow pagination/result anchors with browser.follow_link. Opaque fill/click may write. Never transfers a user tab.
Close and clear this run-owned browser session, including private auth state.
Navigate the existing session across permitted public HTTP(S) origins. Requires latest observation_version and expected_url; returns a fresh observation.
Freeze all network traffic, then observe the existing document without navigation or input. Keeps the context frozen. Current visible state is not proof of a previous external effect.
Observe the current page in an existing session without navigation. Returns current URL, text, links and a fresh observation version.

Follow an ordinary same-origin hyperlink with GET, without click or page handlers. Use this for pagination and result links, including a frozen public GET search page. Requires selector, latest observation_version and expected_url. Refuses downloads, foreign origins, credential state and any prior input/private draft. Returns a fresh frozen observation. Opaque browser.click may write and cannot replace this read operation.

Search or navigate a public same-origin GET form with named ordinary text fields. Use forms metadata from the current observation to choose selector and field names. Compiles a GET URL without click, input, submit or page handlers; POST forms, hidden/password/file fields, credential state and any prior input/private draft are refused. Requires current session, observation_version and exact expected_url. Network freezes again after navigation. This proves a GET observation only, never a remote write.
Click in the existing session after checking latest observation and expected_url. Returns a fresh observation; failed effects require observation before retry.

Fill an input in this session. Use credential_ref for secret values. Returns fresh observation without input values or auth state. Broker-resolved input is compared privately; credential_verified:true confirms field equality only, never successful remote login.

Prepare an input locally with ALL page network frozen persistently, including delayed callbacks. Use credential_ref for secrets. Returns local_preparation:true and network_state:frozen with fresh observation. Only a separately authorized click may release the prepared draft; it may have an unknown external outcome. Broker-resolved input is compared privately; credential_verified:true confirms field equality only, never successful remote login.

Type into an input in this session. Use credential_ref for secret text. Returns a fresh observation. Broker-resolved input is compared privately; credential_verified:true confirms field equality only, never successful remote login.

Prepare an input locally with ALL page network frozen persistently, including delayed callbacks. Use credential_ref for secrets. Returns local_preparation:true and network_state:frozen with fresh observation. Only a separately authorized click may release the prepared draft; it may have an unknown external outcome. Broker-resolved input is compared privately; credential_verified:true confirms field equality only, never successful remote login.
Wait for a visible selector in the current page without navigating. Requires current observation and expected_url. Returns a fresh observation on success.
Read visible text matching a selector from the current page without navigation. Returns a fresh observation version.
Install a broker-resolved cookie credential into this session. cookie must be credential_ref; domain cannot expand the fixed origin. Never returns cookie state.
Install broker-resolved cookies/local storage into the same session and origin. storage_state must be credential_ref; never returns secret state.

Bind to the user's approved browser tab for this Butler session. Reuse the existing active single-tab session when available; otherwise start the tab-selection approval flow and continue the original browser task after approval.
Return the current status of the active bound single-tab session. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Navigate the bound tab to a URL while staying inside the same single-tab session. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Reload the currently bound browser tab. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Navigate backward in the history of the bound browser tab. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Navigate forward in the history of the bound browser tab. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Click an element in the currently bound tab. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Fill an input in the currently bound tab with a plain string value. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Type plain text character-by-character into an input in the bound browser tab. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Send one or more key presses to the focused element in the bound browser tab. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Scroll the bound browser tab by the provided x/y deltas. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Wait for a selector to become visible in the bound browser tab. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Extract visible text from an element or page in the currently bound tab. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.

Capture the currently visible area of the bound browser tab and return an artifact-backed image_ref. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding. Use this directly when the user asks for a snapshot of the approved tab.
Release the current single-tab session. session_id is optional when the current Butler session already has an active tab binding.
Inspect config validation and connectivity for Butler dependencies.
Inspect PostgreSQL and Redis connectivity from the doctor runtime.
Inspect configured Butler service health endpoints without direct Docker control.
Probe provider credentials and reachability from the doctor runtime.
Perform an outbound HTTP request through the HTTP runtime.
Download content from a URL with configurable size limit. Returns the body, content type, size, and truncation status.
Parse HTML content by fetching a URL or from inline content, extracting text matching a simple CSS selector (tag, .class, #id, tag.class, tag#id).

tools.description: Search the public internet with DuckDuckGo Lite. Returns title, URL and snippet per hit. Use for current information, then web.fetch primary sources to verify claims. This is internet search; tools.search only searches the tool catalog.

Read a bounded fresh web page window: 12000 characters by default, up to 24000. Inspect content_window.next_offset and text_hash; continue with text_offset and expected_text_hash to read omitted material. Omitted text is not evidence. Includes bounded discovery links, not official-source certification.

tools.description: Read multiple pages with bounded text windows (at most 24000 characters combined). Inspect each content_window and continue a needed page using web.fetch. Partial failures remain explicit.

Extract bounded UTF-8 text from a URL or inline HTML/text. URL mode requires HTTP 2xx. URL output is capped at 12000 characters; inspect content_window and use web.fetch to continue. Inline model text is not evidence of a page read.
